mechanism_narrative: The level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is always a positive predictor of S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. Lower rates compress discount rates applied to equity cash flows, boosting valuations and leading to positive returns regardless of the absolute rate level.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annualized rate signals inflationary pressure that triggers central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 2.5% in 20% of instances, but 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0% and industrial production (INDPRO) declines for two consecutive months, it indicates an overheating economy with slowing supply, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5.0 and INDPRO decline for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where UNRATE < 5.0 and INDPRO declined for 2 consecutive months, the 5d returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1100, it signals a recovery in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion. This leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy moves into an expansion phase.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1100 in 20% of instances, but 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0%, it indicates a tight labor market that may lead to wage inflation and central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 5.0 in 20% of instances, but 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 and retail sales (RSAFS) falls below 450000, it indicates a simultaneous slowdown in supply and demand, which is a leading indicator of recession. This leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 100 and RSAFS < 450000, the 5d returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: The level of housing starts (HOUST) is always a positive predictor of S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. Higher housing starts indicate a strong economy and rising consumer confidence, leading to positive equity returns regardless of the absolute housing start level.
failure_condition: Rank IC between HOUST and 20d returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 in 20% of instances, but 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of those instances.
